## Delivered, first half · 2026-11-17T12:39Z

PR #34790 merged as `c513d62a` (2026-11-17T12:11Z). The open server's HTTP `initialize` instructions now carry the governed-metric selection rule (only where both `list_datasets` and `query_dataset` register) and the skills install line at the server's own version. Stdio and configured `instructions` are unchanged, as the PR states.

This card stays open. The second half, `/mcp/skill` rendered from the published ask-data skill plus its pin test, goes on branch `claude/issue-34686-skill-single-source` (Fixes #34686) once #34685 (PR #34792) merges. That PR also closes the one known divergence: the served `membersWithheld` sentence in `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` still says "some measures exist", while the skill says members (measures or groupings).
